name: John Cruikshank
office: City of Rancho Palos Verdes, Member of the City Council

items.text: John Cruikshank is a licensed civil engineer. As of 2020, he was president and CEO of JMC2 Civil Engineering + Surveying and OKAMOTO Structural Engineering. He previously served on the Rancho Palos Verdes City Council, including as mayor.

sentences.text: John Cruikshank is a licensed civil engineer.
As of 2020, he was president and CEO of JMC2 Civil Engineering + Surveying and OKAMOTO Structural Engineering.
He previously served on the Rancho Palos Verdes City Council, including as mayor.

items.text: At an October 2026 candidate forum, he said his top priority is obtaining county, state and federal funding for landslide repairs. He opposes Measure RS, which would increase the city's transient occupancy tax. He also highlighted the need for better cell service and fire safety. As mayor in 2024, he and the City Council allocated $2.8 million in county grant money for direct relief to residents affected by landslide damage.
